data.turoyo: Uʕdo ʕfelilux w kobaʕno, d msamḥatli bi ġalṭaṯi diḏi."
data.translation: Ich begnadige dich, bitte dich aber, mir den Fehler, den ich begangen habe, nachzusehen."

rationale: Fourth I Preterit 1 example: Uʕdo plus first-person Preterit performs the pardon now; personal recipient -lux.

data.turoyo: Əšme dat tarte wardani turki lo kuḏaʕno, mən yo. Kubaʕno, d ʕufatli.
data.translation: Den türkischen Namen der Beiden weiß ich nicht. Ich bitte mir das zu verzeihen.

rationale: Fourth I Infectum 1 example: dependent ʕufatli requests forgiveness for a lexical-knowledge failure, without recategorizing it as Imperativ.

data.turoyo: <...> I naqqa du ʕamo kəxli, kəmḥasən hənnək w aq qaše bu miṯo, kəmmi: “Aloho mḥasele! Yaʕni aloho ʕofele!”
data.translation: <...> Während die Leute essen, erbitten sie und die Pfarrer Vergebung für den Toten. Sie sagen: "Gott hab ihn selig!" d. h. Gott verzeihe ihm!

rationale: Fifth I Infectum example: optative forgiveness for a deceased person; explicit synonymous paraphrase clarifies the Turoyo use.

summary: Repair the malformed promise “from you property”.
before: Whatever you want from you property we will give you
after: We will give you whatever you ask for, in wealth or anything else
rationale: “You property” is ungrammatical. The supplied Turoyo has w-u=mede d-ṭulbat gəd-obína-lux m-u=mal w-me-kul mede, a promise by the speakers to give the addressee what he requests. The corpus translation confirms “wir werden dir geben, was du verlangst”; it does not say the addressee must supply his own property.

summary: All 20 occurrences reviewed. Keep I1 verzeihen, begnaden and III1 verzeihen; none requires a new numbered sense.

I encodes forgiven persons with personal l-suffixes or a full direct personal NP (Silo, aḥ ḥaramiye); III at30/158,160 additionally supplies the fault u qṣurayḏan/i qṣuryaṯe with recipient -lan. This does not show that faults require III or persons require I; the sample is too small.
Uʕdo ʕfelilux at36/138 is a performative Preterit. Requests with kobaʕno d ʕofatli remain dependent Infectum. Aloho ʕofele at94/50 andTalay2/10 is an optative prayer, not Imperativ morphology.
At47/47 the priest did not soften and did not say he would pardon; the embedded projected statement must not be reported as an accomplished pardon.
The ḥfele variant is already in the entry at27/71. Allowed lookup returns no ḥfy entry; retain the inherited cross-reference as an unresolved editorial issue, not a new-root claim.
At27/71 hulele ʕafu paraphrases granting amnesty beside the lexical verb; it already belongs to the inherited quotation. No new ʕfy light-verb idiom is needed.
Repair or explain the unresolved inherited →ḥfy cross-reference; does the editor intend an alias entry for ḥfele?
Does the I/III alternation reflect fault-versus-person argument structure or merely lexical/dialectal overlap? The two III tokens come from one episode.
Existing English at36/129 reads 'from you property', whereas supplied German speaks of giving demanded property. Check the source before replacing its language or correcting its exact wording.
